_comment: Viewer settings. Layers come from the point cloud (data/lidar_points.json, written by site-model/houdini/tools/pack_wide.py) and from the design files; this file only gives display names, order, default visibility and colours. Unknown layers still appear under their own name (grey). Design files site-model/exports/design_<name>.glb load on top of the point cloud (listed in assets/models.json); their layers default to the Design style, visible. Camera values are three.js coordinates: x = east, y = up (m, NAVD88), z = -north, from the site origin E 384580 / N 3768520.

time._comment: The Time module (user, 2026-10-13; Space pauses / resumes the opening and the film after it, and after a look around while paused the camera eases back over rejoinS seconds): buildings by the year they were built, each rising from the ground over the buildYears before it, with a soft front (front: its depth, as a share of the building's height). Buildings and landmarks turn white and opaque and stay; the rest goes to contextGrey at contextOpacity; the unbuilt towers keep their colour. undatedDim: the white of buildings with no year.

openingB._comment: Plan B (user, 2026-10-14): the opening's camera follows the building. 2026-10-17 (user: all shots are planned together, once round from Default and back to it): az = [heading at the start of the shot's hold, at its end], degrees counted on (the opening starts on its first shot, not flown in from Default: user, 2026-10-17), through the film (Whole site 200, Broadway 235, Grand Avenue 340, Y-1 back on Default), each group seen from the Y-1 side; wide = the shot is the whole site (2000-2026; the film's own wide shot dropped 2026-10-17: the film flies from here to Broadway); endAz = the heading the opening ends on. endWide false (2026-10-17, user: the fisheye stays at 1 all round, its change between shots showed): no pull-out to the whole site at the end, 2000-2026 frames its buildings within withinM 450 m of Y-1 and Y-1 (the densest is just south of Y-1: Perla on Broadway, 2020), the camera north of Y-1, dist 1.4 (about 740 m; at 526 m a near tower leaned hard in the fisheye). all = frame every building of its years, not only the densest spot (2026-10-16, user: 1867-1980 one shot, the three were close together); dist = a factor on its distance (0.7: about 900 m, a little farther out than the three were, 550-750 m). Shots by years; each frames the densest cluster (most height within clusterM) of the buildings going up in its years, nearer when tight, farther when spread; y1 keeps Y-1 in the frame; the last pulls out to the whole site; turnDeg in all. openingMode A = the old orbit (time.tour).

rates._comment: years a second by period; 2026-10-16 (user: too long) all x 1.75, the opening 53 s -> 30 s

groundFill._comment: ESTIMATED ground under the buildings, where the LiDAR saw only roofs (drawn as ground, in every mode): cellM grid, density = the mean of the ground cells within radiusM, or within the wider radii (widerM) deep under large buildings.

labels._comment: Labels on the buildings going up (blob-tracking frames): at most max new ones at once, the tallest first, for named buildings and landmarks (namedOnly) at least minHeightM tall; only the film's buildings (members of time.cinema.shots) keep their tag once built, fading over fadeYears to doneOpacity; the others fade out over fadeOutYears after holdYears; behind another building (its top hidden) it fades to hiddenOpacity, far ones (past 1.2 x the view distance) to farOpacity, never below minOpacity; a text with no free place hides; one that could not get a label is still eligible holdYears after completion; unbuilt towers always.

cinema._comment: NOW (2026-10-17, user): the film is Broadway (235), Grand Avenue (340), Y-1 (ends on Default); it flies in from the opening's whole site, People coming on as it sets off (thenPeople); the loop goes back to Broadway (loopFrom 0). The history below. After the opening: the film, shots in order (type wide / crane / low / orbit / track; members = entity names or Angels Knoll, their tags lit; cut = dip to black in, else fly; s = seconds; az = the heading the shot starts from; hold = seconds it rests at its end (holdS for shots with members, 0 for wide; it slows to holdDrift of its speed over holdEaseS); reveal = the one shot that starts with Y-1 hidden behind towers and arcs into the clear; loopFrom = the shot the loop returns to after the last; dolly = a crane with a dolly zoom [fov from, to] (2026-10-15: on Y-1, the towers round it grow as the view narrows); aim / tilt / dist = per-shot framing (the tower shots keep the street and its people in the lower third, for scale); degrees: 0 = camera south of its subject, 90 = east, 180 = north, 270 = west; 2026-10-15: chosen per shot where its members are least hidden (__viewer.shotStudy), and the order (a loop round the site: Y-1, California Plaza, west towers, Grand Avenue, Civic Center, Broadway) so the headings only go forward). Groups of places near each other: Y-1 (Angels Knoll, Angels Flight, the Metro), California Plaza and MOCA, Grand Avenue, Civic Center, Broadway, the west towers. thenPeople: People comes on as the film sets off (2026-10-17; it was peopleDelayS into the wide shot), its day starting at peopleStartH (5 = before dawn, most at home), and the film goes on. shotS / blendS seconds; heroes = the tallest labelled towers within heroWithinM of Y-1; labelOpacity = every label while filming (the hero full). on false = stop at the end. 2026-10-16 (user: each shot must show its subject; the last shot, the reveal, already shows Y-1): the track (Metro entrance to Angels Flight, at street level mostly in the trees) dropped, the crane onto Y-1 cut to 5 + 1 s, the west towers from 170 degrees higher and farther (they were hidden at the end), the three orbits 8 s and closer, lengths varied (5 / 6 / 12 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10 / 10 s; the reveal 7 + 3 s). 2026-10-16, last (user): the Y-1 shot ends exactly on Free's Default view (endView: that view's target, distance, tilt and heading, 41 degrees; it comes in from fromDist 1.25 times farther and fromTilt 8 degrees higher; az worked out from its turn). Grand Avenue (350, from the Y-1 side) must then come just before it, so the order is Whole site 160, Broadway 190, Grand Avenue 350, Y-1; the loop goes back to Broadway. Before: 2026-10-16 later at night (user): Civic Center dropped (at the edge of the model), the wide shot 3 s with the 2 s given to the flight after it (fly = a shot's least flight time into it), the last shot (Y-1) no longer a reveal (in a point cloud nothing is really hidden) and turning only 15 degrees. Order and headings: Whole site 330, Grand Avenue 350 (from the Y-1 side: Disney Hall is due north of Y-1 and the model thins past it), Broadway 175, Y-1 280 (2026-10-16, user: the low side view looked off to one side: now from above, about 52 degrees from straight down as in the other orbits, and a little closer (dist 1.1 on the orbit distance: 0.8 was all trees, the tags gone); looking down it is open from 270 to 345), so the loop joins up going forward. Before: 2026-10-16 night (user: the film too long; only the well-known buildings): five shots, the California Plaza and west-tower shots dropped, MOCA joins Grand Avenue, each shot lights only its well-known buildings; headings chosen with shotStudy so they follow on from the wide shot (330, 15, 200, 255, 300; every group in clear view there, Civic Center from the south-west so the camera stays over the model, not past its north edge), loopFrom 1 = Grand Avenue. Earlier: 2026-10-16 later (user): the crane onto Y-1 (the dolly zoom) dropped, the film now 7 shots, loopFrom 1 (back to California Plaza; the wide shot only once). name = the shot's name in the ?shots list (viewer.html?shots: each shot played on its own, for tuning).

tour._comment: The camera while it plays from 1867 (the viewer's opening; opening false = start on today): it ends far out, on the whole site. turnDeg round the site, distance r0 -> r1 (m) and tilt0 -> tilt1 (degrees from straight down), about target.

ghosts._comment: Unbuilt schemes on Y-1 (user, 2026-10-13), from site-model/ghosts/build_angels_landing.py: each tower's points are scattered at random over its walls and roof, as dense as the towers around Y-1 (ghosts.json density, measured by the script), and join the point cloud when it loads, as the estimated facades do: the same point size, thinning with distance and highlight as every building; their own layer (Unbuilt) and colour. inBands of the wall points lie within bandM of a floor line, the rest anywhere on the wall (as the estimated facades: 0.8, 0.25 m), so the storeys show; seed: the same scatter every time.

facades._comment: Estimated wall points (site-model/houdini/tools/synth_facades.py), merged into the Buildings points when the LiDAR loads (user, 2026-10-10).

linked._comment: Point cloud, Color = Layer: points coloured by the layer colours below (user, 2026-10-10): a physical-model look, concrete-grey ground, white buildings, and the coloured layers at one muted saturation (OKLCH chroma about 0.07: vehicles 0.07, trees 0.085 and a little lighter so the planting does not look grey, landmarks a grey violet at 0.055) so the people and the highlight, kept saturated, stand out. Lightness steps apart (ground 0.62, landmarks 0.64, trees 0.75, vehicles 0.74, buildings 0.95), so the layers part in grey too. The clicked object turns the highlight colour unless its layer has "highlight": false (Terrain: too large to light up).

Unbuilt_schematic.label: Unbuilt, schematic
Unbuilt_schematic._comment: Unbuilt schemes known only from descriptions (Three California Plaza): their own layer, apart from those traced from drawings.

perspective._comment: The fisheye lens (Views: Fisheye lens), Guided and Free. on: from the start; fov: what the 50 degree lens becomes (same centre scale, the camera brought in); fisheye: 0 = a wide ordinary lens, 1 = equidistant. Wide shots take time.cinema.wideLens of it.

population._comment: Modeled day/night population (site-model/population/prep_population.py): one point per person, size in metres. start = clock at load (hours), speed = simulated seconds per real second. routeColor / neon / neonStrength: the selected person's light trail (neonStrength scales its opacity). whiteCloud: the 'Highlight people' option - grey level (1 = white) and opacity the point cloud fades to (0.5 s). highlightSize: people's size (m) under 'Highlight people'. colors: Okabe-Ito (colour-blind safe), workers #FFD166 and visitors #06D6A0 from Coolors 'Watermelon Sorbet' (user, 2026-10-09); passers-by #EDEDED, light enough to show on the concrete-grey streets (user, 2026-10-10). isolateAlpha: opacity of everyone else while one person is selected (user, 2026-10-12: 0.15 was too faint, now 0.3).

_mergeLayers: LiDAR layers drawn as another layer in the viewer (user, 2026-10-10): street furniture, walls & fences and the unassigned points join the ground (Terrain, shown as Ground & streets); shrubs join Trees; the LiDAR-only structures join Buildings, except the thin raised ones (splitLayers).
_splitLayers: Objects of a layer sent to another (user, 2026-10-10): LiDAR-only structures whose entity's checked use matches 'uses', or that are thin (less than maxThickM between the 5th and 95th percentile of their heights) and sit on average minHagM-maxHagM above the ground: bridges, raised walkways, street and plaza decks, canopies, drawn with the ground and streets. curved (2026-10-16, freeway ramps and a skybridge near the 110): objects no one has checked by hand also go when they are thin about their own sloping or curving surface (under curved.maxThickM) and sit minHagM-curved.maxHagM above the ground. matchDensity: the moved objects are drawn as densely as the ground around them (points dropped, or drawn larger up to maxSize times).
_treeSpots: Trees the labels missed, checked by hand (user, 2026-10-16: the Watercourt crowns had gone to the ground with Two California Plaza's plaza): circles in local metres (e east, n north of Y-1, r); in each, the ground points more than raiseM above its floor are drawn as a tree of their own.
_plazas: Open ground inside a tower's building outline (plazas, steps, street-level terraces) drawn as ground (user, 2026-10-10, after Two California Plaza / Watercourt): in a building at least minBuildingM tall, every cellM plan cell whose highest return is under maxHagM above the ground. grow / edgeM: cells next to the plaza whose top is no more than edgeM above it (walls and steps down to a lower street) join it, grow cells out.
_claims: A landmark takes the points of building objects within marginM of its own points (user, 2026-10-10: the Angels Flight upper station inside the Two California Plaza outline).
landmarkRule: A building within 1 km of Y-1 is a landmark when (1) it is a City of Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument or individually listed on the National Register of Historic Places (the City's own monument outlines, NavigateLA layer "Historic-Cultural Monuments", downloaded 2026-10-10; historic districts, statues, trees and pending cases left out), or (2) it is a public cultural building (museum, concert hall, theatre, library, place of worship) named as a landmark in the Wikipedia articles "Bunker Hill, Los Angeles" and "Grand Avenue (Los Angeles)". Private office towers, hotels and schools named in those articles (One and Two California Plaza, Wells Fargo Center, the Westin Bonaventure, Gas Company Tower, Colburn School) are not landmarks unless designated.

_landmarks: The Landmarks layer by landmarkRule (user, 2026-10-10, option A, 1 km). One entry per monument; parts: one object name of each entity it covers (a monument outline that covers at least half of an entity's footprint takes that entity), which does not change when auto_entities.py renumbers the automatic entities. name is shown for automatic entities (named by their address) and where rename is set. built / builtSource: the building's own year, looked up 2026-10-10 (the assessor's year built is often a later remodel: Bradbury 1922 for 1893); a landmark without one shows no year. use replaces a wrong assessor use (Central Library: a parking-lot parcel). Every other entity draws as Buildings, also the Pershing Square Metro canopy (a hand-modelled part, not a landmark). ground (user, 2026-10-16): { plazaMaxHagM } in place of plazas.maxHagM for the landmark's objects; 0 = none of it is drawn as a plaza (low wings and market halls whose roofs sit under 10 m above the ground).
